question: What ongoing practice sustains the assembly of yoginīs at all times?
premises: One should partake of that substance.
This should be done at all times.
The assembly of yoginīs may thereby come to be.
inference: By always partaking of that, the assembly of yoginīs may be sustained.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' depends on the preceding verses.
plain_english: One should always partake of that, so that the assembly of yoginīs may take place.
